edge_verdicts.reason: 'His first love Jane' is a passing descriptor of a returning character in a jungle adventure plot; the description centers on action, shipwreck and treasure hunting, not a first-love storyline.
Zara is 'the daughter of a powerful crime lord' and Damon heir to the rival family that killed her brother; feuding crime families are the stable setting and identity frame of the whole plot.
'The heat of their passion becomes the ultimate betrayal' is rhetorical: the leads betray family loyalty by loving each other; there is no betrayal-victim storyline of the kind the tag implies.
Lovers from families that 'have been enemies for generations' is the core premise; 'forbidden love' names the main thread.
'He hunted me down, kidnapped me... I woke up tied to our marriage bed' — the husband's kidnapping and captivity of the heroine is a major plot arc requiring a violent rescue, not a passing mention.
The whole story is a marriage destroyed and its aftermath: the Don abandons 'his wife', she fakes her death, he tries to reclaim her; the marriage is the story's premise.
Olivia being 'a celebrity' crying on TV is a one-line attribute; the plot is coma, betrayal and revenge, with no showbiz setting or industry storyline described.
'意外重生，再睜眼卻成了被人欺凌的鎮南侯府大小姐' — the modern doctor's rebirth into the marquis household is the stated premise driving the whole comeback plot.
She is a '21世紀的天才醫生，驚才絕豔' and her medical genius powers the 神醫嫡女 storyline; genius doctor is her core identity.
'公主' occurs only inside the name 鐵扇公主 (Princess Iron Fan's fan offered as a collectible); the book is an urban shop-system story with no princess character or theme.

'Rosie is a college student working in a fast-food restaurant' is a one-line demographic; the described plot is a tycoon romance plus a murder-frame mystery, with no student life or academics shaping the main thread.

Dante 'is now a top corporate lawyer, and a fine one at that', is hired by a law firm and discovers his boss is Hakim; the lawyer identity and legal workplace frame the entire present-day story, though the plot inside it is the romance.
The book is a bully-to-lover love story ('a workplace romance sparks between him, Hakim...'); romance is the main thread, though it is a male-male pairing some 言情 readers may not expect.

The matched span ('perdu ses anciens Alpha et Luna') is backstory, but the title and premise make Olivia the young Alpha's fated mate ('A-t-il déjà trouvé sa compagne ?'), i.e. the pack's Luna-to-be — the arc Luna-tag readers search for.
'許是上天憐憫讓她一朝重生' — killed at her wedding, she wakes reborn as her enemy's brother's bride and relives her life; rebirth is the core premise.
'弄死個人然後就穿越了' and the narrator missing modern appliances — transmigration is the stated premise of the story, thin as the blurb is.
Sara, 'the house's Chef', is household staff preparing the dinner; chef is a secondary character's job, not a theme or protagonist identity.

The entire excerpt is a wife staging a decisive night for her husband ('Two years of their marriage and she always come up with fabulous surprises'), and the title implies the game plays out inside this marriage; the marital relationship is the story's center.
Aria was 'trained to be both a lethal assassin and a nymphomaniac sex doll'; assassin is her core engineered identity in the premise.
'She has only one mission: revenge' — avenging her murdered parents is the stated main thread.
She was 'stolen away and groomed by a ruthless mafia lord', and the captor/enemy dynamic stays central; the mafia world is the stable setting.
'Luna' is simply the heroine's name ('Namaku Luna Croft') in a casino-debt revenge story; there is no werewolf content at all.
'一朝穿越淪落成不能修煉的傻子廢物' — the medical-family heir transmigrating into a trash body is the core premise of the comeback plot.
'Ta nouvelle Luna' refers to the stepmother's new title in the inciting conflict; the heroine is a wolfless girl sent to the Lycan King, and no Luna arc of her own is described.
Her father is 'l'Alpha de notre meute' and her core identity is 'une fille d'Alpha sans loup'; Alpha authority drives the condemnation-and-tribute premise.
'Cheia de suspense' appears in promotional blurb language; the described plot is a revenge contract-marriage romance turning from hate to love, not a mystery/suspense-driven story.
Dylan marries Darla specifically 'para vingar' his pregnant wife's death; revenge marriage is the core premise and the title.
The vengeance-driven contract marriage ('casando com Darla sob contrato') is the story's central relationship and plot vehicle.
Arriving at 'la Universidad de Houston' is the premise and Kaleb is 'la oscuridad que acecha los pasillos del campus'; the university campus is the story's main stage.
Explicitly framed as 'un Dark Romance para lectores maduros'; the possessive love story is the main thread.
Her master's '蚀骨的背叛' — betrayed and killed after loyal service — is the inciting wound the whole rebirth-revenge arc answers; betrayal-then-payback matches the tag's search intent.
'Tanyag na chef' is one item in a list of Maia's hidden talents (jewelry maker, hacker, chef, game designer); cooking never features as a storyline.
The premise is the parents being 'brutally murdered' and the sisters infiltrating 'the murderers house' for revenge; the crime and its perpetrators are the story's engine.

'Feeling betrayed' refers to the police not genuinely helping, plus a promo list ('Love, revenge, betrayal, crime, jealousy'); no personal betrayal storyline strong enough to form the tag's expectation is described.
Vincent, the male lead, is 'o CEO mulherengo' of the wealthy Stewart family; the wealthy-CEO archetype is his core identity in this romance.
Betrayed Valentina 'seeks solace from the forbidden source – The deadly Mafia Lord' to make her betrayers pay; the Mafia Lord is the male lead and the vehicle of the revenge plot.
The match is the line 'I won't regret it tomorrow' — a negated word inside bedroom dialogue; nothing in the description is a regret/追悔 arc.
Cole, 'um CEO', is the male lead who marries Elliana at the altar and publicly backs her; the CEO-groom archetype anchors the romance.
Her husband 'l'Alpha Graham' betrays her and the redoubtable Alpha Logan becomes her pact partner ('deux Alphas se jaugent'); Alpha figures and pack power are the spine of the plot.

The wronged mate is revealed as 'Luna Larasati' commanding the Council Guard, and the stolen 'kartu Pasangan Alpha' (her Luna-mate card) is a pivotal betrayal; her Luna identity is the story's payoff.
'Alpha itu adalah suamiku, Vincent' — the Alpha husband and his abuse of pack power are the core conflict.

'As love ignites, betrayal strikes' is trailer-style phrasing among 'secrets, sabotage, and shattered loyalties'; no specific betrayal storyline is established as the premise, which is a one-night stand and pregnancy.
'It was supposed to be a one-night stand' with the CEO is the inciting premise of the whole plot.
The bombshell 'I'm pregnant, sir' and her fight 'for her child' drive the story; accidental pregnancy is a core premise.
Heitor is 'um playboy irredutível' living by his own rules; the playboy male-lead archetype is his defining identity in the romance.
Heitor is 'o imponente CEO da agência de modelos New Face', 'a personificação do poder'; the powerful CEO male lead anchors the romance.
Beyond the matched Oz comparison, the book itself is American fantasy tales — Rootabaga Country with corn fairies, zigzag railroads and a floating Village of Cream Puffs; fantasy is the work's genre.

The tales are 'inspired nonsense — loaded with rhythm, humor, and tongue-twisting names'; humor is a defining characteristic of the work, though it is whimsical children's comedy rather than a comedic novel.
She is '鳳城首富杜府的嫡女' displaced by 姨母鳩佔鵲巢; the 嫡女 identity and the household struggle to reclaim her place are the premise.
'智商高達一百八的天才女' — her genius is the stated asset behind 韜光養晦、十倍奉還; a core character identity.
'She is an assassin/agents', the feared group leader at school, and the book's own hook asks 'Bakit nga ba naging isang assassin si Mia?'; assassin is the heroine's core identity.

'Ang Ama n'ya ay isang Mafia Boss' is given as the origin of her assassin identity and frames the underworld side of the story, though the scenes shown are school drama; mafia parentage is a stable premise.

Writing the divorce papers and finally signing 'l'acte de divorce avec mon propre sang' is the climactic turn from betrayed wife to rebirth and revenge; divorce is a pivotal thread, exactly what the tag's readers seek.
A framed man must 'prove his innocence or risk going to prison for a crime he didn't commit'; the murder case and its resolution are the entire plot.
'His lawyer Jill Baker is one of the best criminal attorneys' and 'his only chance to walk away acquitted'; the legal defense is the main thread and the lawyer a lead character.

The male lead is a 'Chủ tịch' who cancels board meetings and says the conglomerate can collapse for her — the wealthy chairman/CEO archetype is his stable identity; the forum post's 'CEO giàu có' mirrors the same pairing.
Killed by the 主母, she returns to her twelve-year-old self ('重生之后才明白，从头到尾就是一个阴谋'); rebirth is the core premise of the mystery-revenge plot.
'She's forced into a contract marriage with Leonardo Castelli' — the contract marriage is the story's premise.
The forced marriage relationship and whether duty becomes real love is the central storyline; a marriage-tag reader finding this contract-marriage romance is reasonable.
The description self-labels '甜宠' in its tag line ('医妃+空间+替嫁+甜宠+男强女更强') and the closing doting banter matches the tone.
'一代天才医者带着神秘空间穿越' — the genius-doctor identity is the heroine's core asset as the 医妃.
'替亲妹妹出嫁冲喜的工具人王妃' — marrying in her sister's place is the premise, also self-labeled 替嫁 in the tag line.
'La notte in cui divenne Alpha, mi umiliò davanti a tutti' — Braydon's Alpha power and the Lycan King's counter-authority structure the whole conflict around the wolfless heroine.
The match is the ship name 'H.M. Ships Adventure and Beagle'; the book is Darwin's nonfiction survey journal, not an adventure novel a 冒险 reader would expect.
'太子悔婚，轉賜廢物王爺' — the crown prince appears only as the fiancé who repudiates her; the male lead is the 邪王, so the crown prince is a discarded secondary figure.
'廢柴變天才，懦女變毒女' with 丹毒典 and 通天塔 in hand — the trash-to-genius transformation is the heroine's core arc.
